{"tests": [{"name": "Happy path with truncation", "given": "Make(\"Hello World!\", 5)", "expect": "\"hello-world\"", "polarity": "success", "covers": "happy"}, {"name": "No truncation with zero max", "given": "Make(\"Hello World!\", 0)", "expect": "\"hello-world\"", "polarity": "success", "covers": "boundary"}, {"name": "No truncation with negative max", "given": "Make(\"Hello World!\", -1)", "expect": "\"hello-world\"", "polarity": "success", "covers": "boundary"}, {"name": "Empty input string", "given": "Make(\\"\\", 5)", "expect": "\"\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:s"}, {"name": "Exact length match", "given": "Make(\"Abc\", 3)", "expect": "\"abc\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "boundary"}, {"name": "Truncate at boundary", "given": "Make(\"Abcdef\", 3)", "expect": "\"abc\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "boundary"}]}

```go
package slug

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestMake(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		s        string
		max      int
		want     string
	}{
		{
			name: "Happy path with truncation",
			s:    "Hello World!",
			max:  5,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "No truncation with zero max",
			s:    "Hello World!",
			max:  0,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "No truncation with negative max",
			s:    "Hello World!",
			max:  -1,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "Empty input string",
			s:    "",
			max:  5,
			want: "",
		},
		{
			name: "Exact length match",
			s:    "Abc",
			max:  3,
			want: "abc",
		},
		{
			name: "Truncate at boundary",
			s:    "Abcdef",
			max:  3,
			want: "abc",
		},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := Make(tt.s, tt.max); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("Make() = %v, want %v", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World!", 5)
	}
}
```
